prompts.prompt: Where is NKI being lost this month?
prompts.answer: Since 22 Oct: the most negative contacts are in Everyday accounts and app (20,332 of 125,117 contacts; top issue New app and update experience). By journey, Switch or close leads switching intent (146 contacts), then Everyday banking (92). NKI target: At least 65; SKI 2026: Swedbank 60.3 of 100 · Sparbankerna 75.2 · industry 66.0.

prompts.prompt: What did the app update cost us in the stores this month?
prompts.answer: Since 22 Oct the stores hold 25 reviews of the app, 13 negative (52%); 12 of the negative ones are about the update, crashes or BankID sign-in. Google Play: 23 reviews, average 3.0 stars; App Store: 2 reviews, average 1.0 stars. Inside the bank, the app update and crash categories carry 28,489 contacts in the window.

prompts.prompt: Which complaints are ARN-eligible this week?
prompts.answer: As of 17 Nov: 2,044 complaints are unhappy with the bank's final decision (ARN eligible), 5,357 have a first reply overdue, and 140 have been filed with ARN. Most at risk: Everyday accounts and app (2,619), then Payments and Swish (2,484). ARN: The customer files in writing after the bank's final decision; 150 kr fee; recommendations are not binding but banks follow them. Eligibility and risk only; LisN does not predict who will file.

prompts.prompt: How many account-measure customers have no owner?
prompts.answer: Last 7 days: 1,042 of the 1,410 account-measure customers due an owner have no owner alerted yet (368 alerted). The cohort raised 8,271 contacts; 2,135 are open. Account-measure review: bank standard, confirm with the bank. FI focus areas: Payment-account access · fraud handling · vulnerable customers · clear information.

prompts.prompt: Where does Nina hand off and lose the customer?
prompts.answer: Since 22 Oct the largest Nina failure is Nina unresolved, had to call (7,807 contacts), then Nina hand-off lost context (5,730). 36,289 of 87,090 Nina conversations closed by 10 Nov (42%) came back as a call or a complaint within 7 days. This week Nina took 34,794 contacts; 4,115 are open.
